name: Generate B2B Leads Daily with DataForB2B and LinkUp

parameters.content:
## 🎯 B2B lead generation on autopilot

Every weekday morning this workflow:
1. Finds fresh leads matching your ICP with **DataForB2B** (800M+ profiles, 50+ filters)
2. Skips anyone already contacted (persistent memory)
3. Sends up to **10 personalized connection requests/day** via **LinkUp API** — safe daily limits

No AI key needed. Perfect first step before message sequences.

## ⚙️ Setup (5 min)

1. **DataForB2B**: create a free API key at [app.dataforb2b.ai](https://app.dataforb2b.ai) → add credentials on the search node
2. **LinkUp API**: get your key at [app.linkupapi.com](https://app.linkupapi.com) and connect your account → add credentials on the invite node
3. Edit the **ICP filters** (title, country, industry, company size, funding...)
4. Personalize the **invitation note** in the last node
5. Activate ✅

⚠️ Keep the daily cap ≤ 15 for account safety.
